📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 2 skills from your past — check your Journal.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Klaus Burns. Chimney sweep. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Reading Glasses, Busker's harmonica, Dispatcher's headset, Trail compass, Brass Locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
